svg.text: lunaZCU111 — 8-channel 3.93 GS/s transient trigger & capture system with integrating spectrometer
Xilinx ZCU111 (XCZU28DR RFSoC) · every sample of 8 RF inputs tested in real time · triggered 8-channel snapshots and 30 kHz-resolution spectra of any one input streamed over Ethernet
Programmable Logic (PL) — VHDL + Xilinx IP + CSIRO filter-bank cores
4 banks × 8 channels × 16384 samples, continuously written ring buffer
on trigger: keep L/2 samples before + L/2 after → trigger in the centre
next bank armed immediately → new events while older ones are read
Integrating spectrometer — any one of the 8 ADCs, clk_spec 122.88 MHz
header 64 B — sequence no., ADC input,
subband, number of spectra, end sample,
each event as a numpy array (8 × L)
axis and mean power per spectrum
all ports open at once: settings can
